iPhone, iPad, Mac

• Distribute your traffic across multiple outbounds simultaneously. • On-Demand functionality for Xray assets. • Switch configurations like a ninja — no restarts needed. Tunna - The Proxy Powerhouse for iOS Tunna isn't your average proxy app. It's a meticulously crafted tool for iOS, built on the rock-solid Xray Core and fully V2Ray compatible. If you're looking for deep control over your network traffic and demand performance, you're in the right place. Tunna speaks your language, supporting VLess, VMess, Trojan, and Shadowsocks out of the box. Heads up: Tunna is a client. You'll need your own proxy servers to get going. ⌘ Granular Traffic Control, Your Way. This is where Tunna shines. Forget basic on/off proxying. We're talking surgical precision: • Route by domain names, IPs (CIDR-aware), or specific ports. • Dive deeper with Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) and Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) protocol-based rules. • Set up intricate routing scenarios that just work. ⌘ iOS On-Demand: Smart & Seamless. Tunna plays nice with iOS. Its On-Demand feature means you set your target domains, and Tunna fires up the right connection automatically when you hit them. No manual switching, just intelligent, background connectivity. ⌘ Live Node Health: No More Guesswork. Wondering about node performance? Tunna's integrated RTT checker is always on, giving you a real-time pulse on latency and health across your configured nodes. You see what's fast, what's not, instantly. ⌘ Zero-Downtime Config: Uninterrupted Flow. Tired of tunnel restarts every time you tweak a setting? Tunna lets you change nodes, update rules, and modify configurations on the fly. Your connection stays live. Your workflow stays smooth. ⌘ Multi-Node Muscle: Beyond Basic Split Tunneling. This is where things get interesting. Tunna allows you to bind different rules to different nodes, simultaneously. • Implement advanced split tunneling with ease. • Go further and split traffic across multiple nodes based on your rules. Stream through one, browse through another – all at the same time. It’s about giving you the power to route traffic exactly how you envision. ⌘ Battery-Friendly by Design. A powerful proxy shouldn't kill your battery. Tunna is optimized for efficiency, especially during device sleep. It respects system states, so you get the power without the drain. ⌘ Management, Simplified. Juggling multiple proxy managed lists? Tunna provides a clean interface to manage and switch between them effortlessly. Tunna is for those who need more than just a toggle switch. It’s for users who want to command their connection, optimize their routes, and demand a stable, flexible, and efficient proxy experience on iOS. If that sounds like you, give Tunna a spin.

results.description:
Tunna - The Proxy Powerhouse for iOS

Tunna isn't your average proxy app. It's a meticulously crafted tool for iOS, built on the rock-solid Xray Core and fully V2Ray compatible. If you're looking for deep control over your network traffic and demand performance, you're in the right place. Tunna speaks your language, supporting VLess, VMess, Trojan, and Shadowsocks out of the box.

Heads up: Tunna is a client. You'll need your own proxy servers to get going.

⌘ Granular Traffic Control, Your Way.

This is where Tunna shines. Forget basic on/off proxying. We're talking surgical precision:
• Route by domain names, IPs (CIDR-aware), or specific ports.
• Dive deeper with Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) and Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) protocol-based rules.
• Set up intricate routing scenarios that just work.

⌘ iOS On-Demand: Smart & Seamless.

Tunna plays nice with iOS. Its On-Demand feature means you set your target domains, and Tunna fires up the right connection automatically when you hit them. No manual switching, just intelligent, background connectivity.

⌘ Live Node Health: No More Guesswork.

Wondering about node performance? Tunna's integrated RTT checker is always on, giving you a real-time pulse on latency and health across your configured nodes. You see what's fast, what's not, instantly.

⌘ Zero-Downtime Config: Uninterrupted Flow.

Tired of tunnel restarts every time you tweak a setting? Tunna lets you change nodes, update rules, and modify configurations on the fly. Your connection stays live. Your workflow stays smooth.

⌘ Multi-Node Muscle: Beyond Basic Split Tunneling.

This is where things get interesting. Tunna allows you to bind different rules to different nodes, simultaneously.
• Implement advanced split tunneling with ease.
• Go further and split traffic across multiple nodes based on your rules. Stream through one, browse through another – all at the same time. It’s about giving you the power to route traffic exactly how you envision.

⌘ Battery-Friendly by Design.

A powerful proxy shouldn't kill your battery. Tunna is optimized for efficiency, especially during device sleep. It respects system states, so you get the power without the drain.

⌘ Management, Simplified.

Juggling multiple proxy managed lists? Tunna provides a clean interface to manage and switch between them effortlessly.

Tunna is for those who need more than just a toggle switch. It’s for users who want to command their connection, optimize their routes, and demand a stable, flexible, and efficient proxy experience on iOS. If that sounds like you, give Tunna a spin.
